name: GitLab merge request review
description: Review labelled GitLab merge requests at their current head after a scheduled scan or signed webhook event, and post a concise, non-approving review note with actionable findings.

gitlab.message: Requires a connected GitLab account or GITLAB_TOKEN with api scope to read merge requests and post notes. MCP-only access is not supported.

exampleImplementation: Choose cron to scan labelled open merge requests or event to respond to signed merge_request webhooks from a pre-registered custom GitLab source. Verify the project, label, state and exact head against GitLab's API; the event run waits for its review to finish before publishing one note per head. Do not approve or merge.

schedule.label: Check frequency
schedule.help: How often to check for labelled merge requests.

source.label: Signed GitLab webhook source
source.help: First register a custom webhook with standard_webhooks signature verification, then select its source here. Configure GitLab 19.0+ to deliver merge request events using the same signing token. See this reviewer's README for setup steps.

on.label: GitLab events
on.help: React to merge request open, update and reopen events. The worker checks the live project, label and MR state before reviewing.

projects.label: Projects
projects.help: GitLab projects to review. Subgroups are supported.

triggerLabel.label: Trigger label
triggerLabel.help: Only open merge requests carrying this label are reviewed.

gitlabApiUrl.label: GitLab API URL
gitlabApiUrl.help: HTTPS /api/v4 root of the instance. Requires a connected GitLab account or GITLAB_TOKEN; MCP-only access is not supported.

setup.message: This deployment cannot run the bundled reviewer directly. Offer a scheduled poll, or ask the user to register a signed GitLab custom webhook source named gitlab and configure its merge request webhook before setting up an event-triggered review.
